column1: # Alert IDs reviewed and accepted after the first real baseline scan run -
# see README > Dynamic scanning. Re-evaluate whenever the app changes in a
# way that could make one of these stop being a non-issue (same discipline
# as the npm audit acceptance table in the same README section).
# 10027 Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments: false positive. The
#   one instance is a substring of React's own minified production runtime
#   ("...likely caused by a bug in React. Please fi[le an issue]..."),
#   flagged because it contains "bug" - not a comment this project wrote,
# 10109 Modern Web Application: purely descriptive ("consider the Client
#   Spider instead of the standard one") - not a finding, no action possible.
# 10049 Storable and Cacheable / Storable but Non-Cacheable Content: both
#   instances are the intended, deliberate behavior documented in README >
#   Performance (immutable long-lived caching for content-hashed JS/CSS) and
#   the SPA-fallback index.html (no-cache) - neither serves anything
